covers.description: the content ids of the cuts merged into this one

max_bps.description: above 25000000 only on a landscape canvas, at most the level's MaxBR (decision 0027)

kind.description: the part's picture covering the canvas, blurred and dimmed (decision 0014)

blur.description: the picture is resampled to canvas/blur and back up

kind.description: a video or still under every part on the output clock (decision 0028)

audio_track.description: the container track id parts' audio is read from (decision 0009); absent = the first audio track

em_per_size.description: unitsPerEm/(usWinAscent+usWinDescent); hhea ascent−descent when OS/2 is absent; verified in S4

safe_zones.description: TikTok/Shorts/YouTube zones join in /1 (S3-mac measures them)

range.description: [start, end) integers; start < end is a validator rule

kind.description: agent = an agent-typed value with no other provenance

ease.description: an eased visual split: crop, place and opacity move from from_* to the layer's own over the part's first frames (decision 0016)

cover.description: a cover layer: its crop is drawn into place blurred, pixelated or as a solid fill (decision 0021)

cursor.description: a cursors[].id of the layer's picture source, drawn over it through its crop and place (decision 0045)

frame.description: rounded corners, a shadow beneath and a border on top (decision 0046)

first_frame.description: with picture_source: that source read live from this frame at the part's first output frame (decision 0046)

fps.description: with picture_source: that source's nominal rate when it differs from output.fps; first_frame then counts output.fps frames on its presentation clock (decision 0047)

layer_track.description: a cover pinned to a moving point: on output frame f its place moves by p(f) - (x, y) rounded to whole pixels and its crop by that move scaled by crop/place (decision 0033)

radius.description: canvas px: the crop is resampled down to place/radius and back up with a cubic B-spline
corner radius as a fraction of the placed rectangle's short side (0.5 on a square place: a circle)

blur.description: the soft edge's width, a fraction of the canvas's short side

offset_y.description: moved down by this fraction of the canvas's short side

width.description: inside the rounded edge, a fraction of the canvas's short side

under.description: other sources heard under the part's audio, each at its own gain (decision 0051)

native.description: informational: the stream-clock frame range this part came from

size.description: nominal; ASS units at PlayResY = canvas.h
final size, ASS units (\fs); renderers never refit (rule 6)

pop_runs.description: runs whose fill pops in (keyword animation)

z.description: drawn among the part's layers, in their z space (decision 0042)

clip_picture.description: which frame of a video a backdrop or clip event shows (decision 0028)

frames.description: the media's length in output frames

clip_event.description: a video picture-in-picture over [out[0], out[1]), above every part layer, under every overlay (decision 0028); with z, among the part's layers, and a matte cuts it out (decision 0042)

z.description: drawn among the part's layers, in their z space (decision 0042)

audio_overlay.description: music or a sound effect over the output samples out_samples, read from first_sample on (decision 0051)

duck.description: lowered by depth_db inside audio.speech, eased over attack_samples before and release_samples after

part_speed.description: a part played at num/den times (1/4 to 4, never 1 unless it ramps; decision 0030), or ramping from it (decision 0033)

speed_ramp.description: the speed eases from the part's num/den to `to` over output frames [from, from + frames) of the part, then holds `to`; the source advances by the speed's integral (decision 0033)

cursor_track.description: a recorded cursor: one picture source's gmclip.input/1 track and its cursor images by shape index (decision 0045)

layer_ref.description: a layer of one part: parts[].id and that part's layers[].id

zoom.description: a zoom section (decision 0046): the named layers drawn through a crop depth x tighter, centred on the target, eased in and out

event_track.description: an overlay pinned to a moving point (decision 0031)
